components.title: ASCII Gyroscope
components.brief: Three inclined wire rings precess around a fixed center, drawn in glyphs with clear depth and ample empty ground. It is wrong if this becomes a filled solid, a flat set of identical circles, or tiny unreadable phone glyphs. Use the existing core, wrapper and metadata contract. This is an original standalone visual asset, not a themed page or app. Defaults must be finished at 1280 and 390 on ink and paper. Provide exactly three named presets with descriptions and JSON props. Expose paused, time, seed and speed, use createLoop only, and preserve the host exactly on destroy. Keep the effect calm. No external design references, dependencies, network requests, hardcoded colors, or shared runtime changes. Use the four palette roles and declare only tokens visibly used.  Use createGrid and fixed readable glyph sizes on narrow hosts. Braille subcell lines are allowed. Shape glyphs follow geometry; density glyphs use measureRamp. Do not use a 2D canvas directly or shrink the entire object into a tiny strip. Stay within the 6 KB ASCII budget.
